inputs: Hashed SEC submission column arrays already acquired for each company; only filing dates strictly before prediction.
unknown_items: If any 8-K in a window has unknown item indexing, its item-based counts are missing, never zero. Exact form counts remain observable.
feature_clipping: Quantile-clip original financial features only. Preserve sparse filing-event counts and missingness indicators rather than clipping rare signals to zero.
partitions: Enrich training and calibration only; do not read final feature rows or make final predictions.
